assert saved==result

    amount=r['amount']; sign=-1 if amount.startswith('-') else 1

    cents=sign*(int(whole)*100+int(fraction))
    totals[r['currency']]=totals.get(r['currency'],0)+cents

saved=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert saved==expected
assert saved['totals']=={'EUR':'189.19','USD':'398.07'}
assert len(saved['includedIds'])==21
assert not {'INV-007','INV-014','INV-021'}.intersection(saved['includedIds'])
print('Saved and read-back verified close1.json: policy v1, EUR 189.19, USD 398.07, 21 sorted IDs; last-occurrence deduplication and void exclusion applied.')
